correctness.rationale: Exact Green-area quadratic kernel for the paired support arcs, moment constraints and support-density convexity are reconstructed. For any admissible difference f, p=sin-kernel*f has p=p' =0 at both endpoints and Q(f)=∫(p²-p'²)<0 by Dirichlet Poincaré, including length π. The candidate has the exact cosine-multiplier obstacle 0 in the center and 1-cos(|x|-alpha)>0 on outer saturated intervals, making the first variation nonpositive and the quadratic remainder strictly negative. The exact F(m) derivative factors through u(u²+u-4), yielding the unique global angle; rational inverse-sine enclosures certify stated coarse area bounds, and explicit polygonization checks corroborate the formulas.
